title: Dashboard
overview: This guide covers dashboard workflows for Provider.

subtasks.title: Provider Dashboard (welcome & practice landing)
subtasks.purpose: Land the Provider on their assigned practice, confirm sign-in role and expose the practice-detail tab bar.

steps.title: Sign In as Provider
steps.description: Sign in with the Provider credentials. The Dashboard opens on the assigned practice.

steps.title: Read Welcome Toast
steps.description: Read the welcome toast (top-right) to confirm the role and practice.

steps.title: Confirm Enrollment Counters
steps.description: Confirm the enrolment counters — <N> CCM (green heart) and <N> RPM (blue heart) — beneath the practice name.

steps.title: Switch Between Tabs
steps.description: Use the horizontal tab bar to move between Practice, Admins, Providers, Caregivers, Patients, System Caregivers, RPM, Schedule & Targets and Import Patients.

steps.title: Use Header Shortcuts
steps.description: Use the header bell for notifications, the info (i) icon for release notes and the username dropdown (top-right) for Logout / Change Password / My Account. Notes Providers see practice-scoped data only — the top-level Practice List / Enrollment views used by Super Admin and System Admin are hidden. CCM / RPM counters on the header reflect currently enrolled patients across all statuses; use the Patients tab for a live filterable grid. The welcome toast can be dismissed with the × icon and will not reappear until the next login. Task 8.2 — Practice Detail (tabbed workspace)
